typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DynamicFileName as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	FullPath as string (),
	InboundPath as string (),
	OutboundPath as string (),
	OutputFileName as string (),
	SheetName as string (),
	SheetRange as string (),
	SuccessEmail as string ()
}

source(output(
		{IT Team} as string,
		SystemList as string,
		Description as string,
		{Issue Priority} as string,
		IssueType as string,
		{Fix Version} as string,
		Summary as string,
		Labels as string,
		WorkID as string,
		Component as string,
		DueDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[JIRA_OOS_Automation',
	schemaName: 'UTE [dbo]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		IT_Team as string,
		SystemList as string,
		Description as string,
		Issue_Priority as string,
		IssueType as string,
		Fix_Version as string,
		Summary as string,
		Labels as string,
		WorkID as string,
		Component as string,
		DueDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		IT_Team = {IT Team},
		SystemList,
		Description,
		Issue_Priority = {Issue Priority},
		IssueType,
		Fix_Version = {Fix Version},
		Summary,
		Labels,
		WorkID,
		Component,
		DueDate)) ~> FlatFileDestination
